issues.title: E90031 members missing this morning
issues.body:
Hi, Synthetic Supplies rang. Their new joiners from Monday's file aren't showing. Same for two other employers I think (E90044 and E90052?). The files definitely arrived on the 9th because ops confirmed it. Is it the files or is it us?

Thanks, Mel (Employer Relations)

issues.title: job crashes if a file isnt there
issues.body:
ran python -m pipeline.ingest_members with yesterday's list. one of the files had been moved by ops and the whole thing died with a FileNotFoundError traceback. the other files in the list never loaded.

surely it should say that file is rejected and carry on, like it does for a bad trailer?

issues.title: feeds imports pipeline.settings
issues.body:
the feeds reader pulls STRICT_SCHEMA out of pipeline.settings. thats a library module importing from the jobs package, and it means you cant use read_file from a notebook without the pipeline package on the path.

read_file already takes strict=... so the jobs could just pass it in? not urgent but it bugs me every time i see it. settings.py itself shouldnt need to change.

issues.title: No audit event when a member file is rejected
issues.body:
Audit asked which member files we turned away in October and I had to grep the logs to answer. We record member_file_loaded but nothing at all when a file is rejected.

Can we record an event for that too? Same actor. Put the reason in the detail but no field values obviously.

issues.title: member job: total line at the end
issues.body:
when you give the member job 30 files you get 30 lines and have to count the rejected ones by eye. a last line like

    30 files: 28 loaded, 2 rejected

would do. keep the per-file lines as they are, the scheduler greps them.

issues.title: Email late payers automatically
issues.body:
Could the contributions job just email the employer's payroll contact when they are on the late list? It would save us an afternoon every month. We have the addresses in the employer system.

Sam (Finance Ops)
